explanationMd: A fourth root of 16 is 2, and cubing it gives 8. Equivalently, 16 = 2⁴, so (2⁴)^(3/4) = 2³. Fractional exponents combine roots and powers.

distractorRationale.d: This multiplies the base by the exponent instead of applying a fractional power.
distractorRationale.b: This gives only the square root.
distractorRationale.e: This uses the square root and then cubes rather than the fourth root.
distractorRationale.a: This gives only the fourth root and omits the cube.
